🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology: CRM (1W: +22.39% | 1M: +41.66%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +12.63% | 1M: +31.47%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +14.05%) ABOVE TREND. Communication: META (1W: +5.11% | 1M: +7.23%) ABOVE TREND. Financials: CME (1W: +3.93% | 1M: +6.95%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?

Healthcare: LLY (1W: -6.44% | 1M: +1.85%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: +0.73% | 1M: -6.77%) RECOVERY. Industrials: BA (1W: -2.04% | 1M: -5.02%) BELOW TREND, CAT (1W: -3.34% | 1M: -1.10%) BELOW TREND.

Note MAJOR divergence: multiple large caps (AAPL RECOVERY, TSLA CORRECTION, XOM CORRECTION) show 1W vs 1M direction mismatch — tactical volatility, watch for trend break.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech mixed but leading on headline movers; sector 1W: +2.21% | 1M: +10.56% (24 stocks). Key names: CRM (1W: +22.39% | 1M: +41.66%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +14.05%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: -6.23% | 1M: -7.89%) BELOW TREND — internal rotation and leadership narrow.

8. Financials Outlook?

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare under pressure 1W: -1.64% | 1M: +4.06% (17 stocks). Names to watch: JNJ (1W: -0.32% | 1M: +5.29%) CORRECTION, LLY (1W: -6.44% | 1M: +1.85%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: +0.73% | 1M: -6.77%) RECOVERY — defensive dynamics mixed with stock-level dispersion.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective Technology leaders showing ABOVE TREND (CRM, MSFT) and core Financials strength (JPM, CME); reduce exposure to weak/high-volatility names showing BELOW TREND (PYPL, AMAT, ROST). Monitor major divergence (AAPL RECOVERY, TSLA CORRECTION) before adding beta — style mixed / no clear leadership.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. CRM (1W: +22.39% | 1M: +41.66%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +14.05%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +17.22%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength.
